articles.title: Microsoft Exchange Flaw Lets Authenticated Attackers Read Other Users' Mailboxes
articles.summary:

articles.title: Realtek Jungle SDK Exploit Attempts Deliver Cling Botnet With STUN-Based C2
articles.summary:
Threat actors have been observed attempting to exploit a now-patched critical security flaw impacting the Realtek Jungle software development kit (SDK) to deploy a botnet malware called Cling.

"Cling is notable not because it introduces a new propagation technique, but because it repurposes ordinary STUN behavior into a practical command-and-control channel," Nozomi Networks said in a report

articles.title: Apple Plans Tighter macOS Full Disk Access Controls Over AI Agent Data Access
articles.summary:
Apple has announced that it's taking steps to tighten controls around a macOS setting called Full Disk Access (FDA) due to security risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) agents.
